Audit 2318 software enrollment acceptance

Run once in the existing macOS Swift core/native row, after its Go setup and CLI
build. Reuse that CLI and the same Swift core scratch/build system:
  bash .github/scripts/test-mac-enrollment.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/mac-enrollment" "$RUNNER_TEMP/swift-core" PATH_TO_THIS_HEAD_CLI default
Use native instead of default only when the row uses native for both Swift build
and test. No new job, runner, signed app, login item, Cloud account or device is
created. The helper build has a 180s bound; incremental Swift build has 600s;
actual runtime has 140s. Native measured runtime was 1.66s. Cold CI build cost
still depends on the existing row's cache; no new dependency tree is requested.

The standalone Go peer owns only random loopback listeners and a new private
0700 directory. Random disposable Cloud bearer/EAB credentials and operator keys
stay there. The CLI uses explicit file-backed configuration and a private HOME.
The local development Cloud dial uses WENDY_CLOUD_INSECURE=true, scoped to the
child CLI only; actual device enrollment switches to real mTLS. ACME uses the
production HTTP client against a loopback HTTP peer, with validated ES256 JWS,
fresh nonces, EAB MAC/account-key binding, permanent UUID order, signed CSR and
issued certificate. Operator-signed Cloud request bytes/scope are checked with a
fresh ML-DSA key. These controlled peers are not production PKI/Cloud acceptance.

The Swift test starts WendyAgent through its production service registry and
callbacks. Its internal factory forces software keys, retains live ACME, and
uses a fresh private provisioning directory. Its controlled empty camera avoids
hardware/control restoration. Loopback configuration suppresses Bonjour/Cloud
relay. The public initializer and production factory default remain unchanged.
The test never starts/stops the user's app, touches Secure Enclave/Keychain,
changes trust stores, or invokes make agent-start/agent-stop.

Actual CLI device enroll must first refuse both a live v1-only RPC peer and a
production Agent advertising unavailable ACME, before Cloud/ACME counts change.
Normal enrollment must spend exactly one EAB/account/order/CSR issuance, return
CLI success after its authenticated reconnect, save the selected identity binding,
and persist the exact Cloud-minted UUID. A fresh Agent object then reloads the
unchanged state/key, serves the same v2 identity over authenticated mTLS, and
rejects a client without a certificate. Restart must not repeat issuance.
Fixed loopback ports18820/18821 must be free; collision fails rather than dialing
another process. No skipped test or missing marker can pass the wrapper.

Children receive bounded termination through their Foundation Process objects;
no saved numeric PID is killed. Unknown drain fails and retains owned files.
The outer shared guardian bounds inherited process descendants. The peer owns
no child processes and joins all three listener goroutines before exit. Private
credentials/state are removed only after known child and Agent drain. Retain only
build.log/runtime.log/evidence.json, not peer binaries, private state or keys.

The audit's full packaged-Agent requirement remains separate: signed bundle
registration, Aqua launch/launchd, real Keychain/Secure Enclave and package update
are not established by this software test. Reuse the existing reserved-account
mac-agent-lifecycle-rehearsal procedure for that acceptance; all such execution
remains not_run until an owner supplies actual signed-package evidence.
